verdict.rationale: Retell documents drag-and-drop, node-based conversation flows built in the dashboard (retell-docs-25, retell-docs-17), and Conductor can edit those flows from plain-language requests (retell-docs-54). Human handoffs are supported through the Transfer Call tool with cold, warm and agentic warm modes (retell-docs-63), though that page is documented for single/multi-prompt agents rather than explicitly as a flow node. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of branching conditions and state/node transitions in the visual builder, confirmation that transfer is a node in the flow builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-code builder experience.
